title: Paloma and the Will
author: Silas Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Thornbury, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
